svg.title: LoRA mechanism — annotated scheme
svg.desc: Animated watercolor pictogram of a head with brain. The scheme reveals the BASE MODEL annotation (arrow then card) pointing at the brain, then the pictogram progressively grows three stacked LoRA adapter plates above the head (green, then blue, then terracotta), and finally the ADAPTERS annotation reveals (arrow then card) pointing at the plate stack. The cycle then resets.
